类 InMemoryLibraryRepository

java.lang.Object
cn.vcampus.library.InMemoryLibraryRepository
所有已实现的接口:
LibraryCatalogV4, LibraryRepository
public final class InMemoryLibraryRepository extends Object implements LibraryRepository, LibraryCatalogV4
Thread-safe repository used by tests and server demo mode.
